ScriptCondition.name: NeedsLargeTurn
ScriptCondition.code: function yaw(q) siny_cosp = 2.0 * (q.w * q.z + q.x * q.y) cosy_cosp = 1.0 - 2.0 * (q.y * q.y + q.z * q.z) return math.atan2(siny_cosp, cosy_cosp) end curr_yaw = yaw(current_pose.orientation) goal_yaw = yaw(goal.orientation) return math.abs(curr_yaw - goal_yaw) > 0.6
